title: The Ruinous Hand Canon
summary: A canon for students past the courses on the hand that ruins plate and latch and stonework in a single pass.

title: A Treatise on the Unmaking Field
summary: A treatise on spreading the qi field so that the techniques cast inside it come undone one instance at a time.

title: The Twin Fracture Treatise
summary: A treatise on fracturing in pairs so that a first crack is joined by a second and the piece parts between them.

title: The Azure Breaching Canon

title: The Wind-Sworn Unmaking Reckoning
summary: A reckoning of unmaking carried on the wind and the oath not to unmake what the wind-sworn have sworn to keep.

title: Treatise on Bearing and Breaching
summary: A treatise on taking a bearing on the weak point of a thing and breaching it along that line.
